newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore October container throughput up 14 pct.
newsitem.headline: Singapore October container throughput up 14 pct.

text.p: The Port of Singapore Authority (PSA) said on Friday October container throughput rose to 1.327 million TEUs (20-foot equivalent units), up 14 percent from the previous month.
But total cargo tonnage moving through Singapore in October fell to 26.048 million tonnes from 26.650 million tonnes.
In October, 10,219 vessels called at the port, compared with 9,840 in September.
Bunker fuel sales for 380 centistoke fuel oil came to 749,000 tonnes in October, down from 790,000 tonnes in September.
The 180 centistoke fuel sales were 369,000 tonnes against September's 395,000 tonnes.
